name: Pogolo
confidence_why: 2 independent first-hand descriptions agree (1 state the same rule, 0 refine it); none contradicts.

audit.action: a better source should be cited for the same classification
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: we held nothing; I downloaded the exact cited archive.org item and the deciding sentence is there verbatim at Lautlehre sec. 5 'Der Wortton', p. 5, with the -la enclitic exception and the re-penultimization in compounds exactly as our record summarizes. (2) Deciding source: a 1907 missionary grammar-plus-dictionary (Glottolog listed by Glottolog as a grammar, 189 pp), impressionistic, one paragraph on stress; but Glottolog lists no other grammar, sketch or phonology for pogo1243, and web search (SIL, UDSM/UDOM repositories, journals, Wikipedia/Glottolog refs) turned up no phonology or prosody study; the one other open Pogolo thesis (Lihundi 2018) is silent. So the record rests on the best, and only, available description. (3) Coding 'fixed-dominant, penultimate' matches the source; the only lexical/clitic exception (-la) is already noted. Nothing found contradicts it, and penultimate stress

sources.citation: Hendle 1907, Die Sprache der Wapogoro, archive.org diesprachederwa00hendgoog djvu text, sec. 5 Der Wortton, full section read; sole exception is the enclitic -la
sources.quote: Der Ton ruht stets auf der vorletzten Silbe; eine einzige Ausnahme bilden alle jene unbetonten Fersonalpronomina und einsilbigen Orts- und Zeitpartikeln, welchen -la nur, gerade angehängt wird. In diesem Falle behält -la immer den Ton.

sources.citation: Hendle, P. J. 1907. Die Sprache der Wapogoro (Deutsch-Ostafrika) nebst einem Deutsch-Chipogoro und Chipogoro-Deutschen Wörterbuch. Berlin: Reimer. (archive.org diesprachederwa00hendgoog; djvu text + PDF)
sources.quote: 'Der Ton ruht stets auf der vorletzten Silbe'; sole exception: enclitic -la 'nur, gerade' attached to unstressed personal pronouns and monosyllabic place/time particles keeps the stress (gU'lä, pa-lä); when such forms combine with another word into one unit, stress is again penultimate (ulawinno).
sources.locator: Teil I Lautlehre, sec. 5 'Der Wortton', printed p. 5 (djvu the text)
